## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `python -m pytest -q` passes (frontend: `npm test && npm run lint && npm run build`)
- [ ] New detection rules have an id, a plain-English `why`, a test that fires, and a test for a look-alike that must stay Low
- [ ] No real credentials, personal data, keys or leaked material in the diff ([SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md))
- [ ] User-visible changes are noted in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] Any accuracy claim names the data it was measured on
